from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(bytes=[], config={}, filename="empty.txt", kind=ExtractInputKind("bytes"), mime_type="text/plain")

    print(result)
